- Paging: page-based (`page`, `per_page`); items in `workflow_runs` (with `total_count`); `Link` header
- Responses: `200`: application/json object (headers: `Link`)

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values / constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `owner` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `repo` | path | string | yes |  |  |
| `workflow_id` | path | integer \| string | yes |  |  |
| `actor` | query | string |  |  |  |
| `branch` | query | string |  |  |  |
| `event` | query | string |  |  |  |
| `status` | query | string |  |  | one of: `completed`, `action_required`, `cancelled`, `failure`, `neutral`, `skipped`, `stale`, `success`, `timed_out`, `in_progress`, `queued`, `requested`, `waiting`, `pending` |
| `per_page` | query | integer |  | `30` |  |
| `page` | query | integer |  | `1` |  |
| `created` | query | string (date-time) |  |  |  |
| `exclude_pull_requests` | query | boolean |  | `false` |  |
| `check_suite_id` | query | integer (int64) |  |  |  |
| `head_sha` | query | string |  |  |  |
